column1: A pull-up bar and dip bars are the minimum equipment needed for most calisthenics training, and they're available in many outdoor workout parks. If you're a complete beginner, resistance bands can make learning progressions easier by providing assistance. On the other hand, if you want to incorporate weighted calisthenics, investing in a dip belt, weight plates, and a weighted vest is a great option.
